page.layout: One printed page with a heading at the top; below it two parallel tables of three columns each (Psalm/Cap., Verse, Page), separated by a double vertical rule. No marginal notes. No page number or running head printed.

main_text.head: Index IV.
main_text.l: Psal. | Vers. | Pag. || Cap. | Vers. | Pag.

page.notes: Column headings "Pag." and "Cap." appear at the top of each table. The final "Cap." at the lower right is a catchword-like label, left in the list. Several Roman numerals and page numbers in the scan are blurred; readings of the Psalm and chapter columns are best effort. The first table's rows are aligned to the second table's rows as printed.
